translations.web: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
translations.bsb: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
translations.kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
translations.asv: wranglings of men corrupted in mind and bereft of the truth, supposing that godliness is a way of gain.
